source_confirmation.reuse: Reuse every data, split, model, optimization, checkpoint, budget, seed, baseline, and fixed-self-loop setting without retuning.

groups.definition_stage: Original hypergraph before sparsification and before adding fixed singleton self-loops.
groups.connected: Nodes with original incidence degree greater than zero.
groups.isolated: Nodes with original incidence degree equal to zero.
groups.comparison_rule: Intersect each fixed group with the common test split; compare EHGNN-F and Random-Fixed on identical node indices.

secondary_metrics: fraction of originally connected nodes retaining at least one selected incidence
evaluation.statistical_reporting: Two-sided paired t confidence intervals and p-values; Holm correction across the 16 dataset-budget-group comparisons.

integrity_checks.exact_budget: Every method retains K=max(1,floor(rho*t)) original incidences.
integrity_checks.subgroup_reconstruction: The test-count-weighted connected and isolated accuracies must reconstruct overall test accuracy within 1e-5 percentage points.
integrity_checks.aggregate_reproduction: Report the maximum per-run aggregate test-accuracy difference from the source results.

interpretation.no_result_selection: Report both groups, both datasets, every budget, and all ten seeds irrespective of outcome.
interpretation.scope: This stratification explains where a method difference occurs; it does not replace the full-test-set comparison or justify removing isolated nodes.
interpretation.claim_rule: Use significance language only for Holm-adjusted p<0.05; otherwise report the effect descriptively.
